construction: Actual continuous original conversation; no concatenation, endpoint rescue, time stretching, reordered turns, synthesized gaps or overlap removal.
selection_rule: Frozen in data-selection.json before any followup model outputs; earliest eligible original120s window per new conversation, both edges in speech-annotation gaps>=10ms; majority lexical turn count and>=60% summed lexical duration from0.5-15s turns.

gap_statistics.definition: Original gaps in union of speech annotation, not guaranteed acoustic silence

boundary_statistics.policy: Original lexical speech never cut; nonspeech/background may remain at crop edges.

timing_limitations: Energy-derived end is shared, not lexical ground truth; overlap/background can bias it. Timing-only intervals remain separate. Nonempty coverage does not establish correct text.

historical_noise.processing: Common16k mono, subtract mean,100ms linear tail-to-head crossfade. Periodic indexing from frozen offset; real recorded noise only, no speech synthesis.
historical_noise.independent_realization: Different original field recording per environmental realization; offsets deterministic before inference.

historical_reuse: Recovered ES2004d32.368–152.368s original manual turn/reference timing; changed original audio from historicalmeanof4headsets to publicMix-Headset. HistoricalFLOAThashes are not currentaudiohashes. Shared speech ends recomputed on actual clean mixed source before inference; original-profilepink15 applied.
